lesson: In parse_flag, the only truthy values permitted are exact lowercase 'true' and 'on', with values like '1', 'yes', and case-insensitive variants rejected.
why: Older configurations rely on 'on' and cannot be broken, whereas '1' and 'yes' originated from a bad importer and case-insensitivity caused accidental flag activations in production.
quote: the truthy set is exactly 'true' and 'on', case-sensitive. '1', 'yes', 'True', 'On' all -> False.
